1.text: Mbashimiye Foyibe mushiki wacu ari we mudiyakonikazi w'Itorero ry'i Kenkireya,

2.text: ngo mumwakire ku bw'Umwami wacu nk'uko bikwiriye abera, kandi mumufashe mu byo azabashakaho byose, kuko na we yafashije benshi barimo jye.

3.text: Muntahirize Purisikila na Akwila, bakoranye nanjye muri Kristo Yesu,

4.text: kandi bemeye gutanga imitwe yabo gucibwa kugira ngo bankize. Si jye jyenyine ubashima, ahubwo n'amatorero yo mu banyamahanga yose arabashima.

5.text: Muntahirize Itorero ryo mu rugo rwabo, muntahirize na Epayineto uwo nkunda, ari we muganura w'abo muri Asiya bahindukiriye Kristo.

7.text: Muntahirize na Andironiko na Yuniya dusangiye ubwoko, bari babohanywe nanjye ari ibirangirire mu ntumwa. Ni bo bambanjirije muri Kristo.

8.text: Muntahirize Ampuliyato uwo nkunda mu Mwami wacu.

9.text: Muntahirize Urubano ukorana natwe muri Kristo, na Sitaku uwo nkunda.

10.text: Muntahirize Apele wemewe muri Kristo. Muntahirize abo mu bo kwa Arisitobulo.

11.text: Muntahirize Herodiyoni dusangiye ubwoko. Muntahirize abo mu bo kwa Narukiso bari mu Mwami wacu.

12.text: Muntahirize Tirufayina na Tirufosa bakorera mu Mwami wacu. Muntahirize Perusi ukundwa, wakoreye mu Mwami cyane.

13.text: Muntahirize Rufo watoranijwe mu Mwami, na nyina ni nka mama.

14.text: Muntahirize Asunkirito na Fulegoni, na Herume na Patiroba, na Heruma na bene Data bari hamwe na bo.

15.text: Muntahirize Filologo na Yuliya, na Neru na mushiki we, na Olumpa n'abera bose bari hamwe nabo.

16.text: Muramukanishe guhoberana kwera. Amatorero ya Kristo yose arabatashya.

17.text: Ariko bene Data, ndabinginga ngo mwirinde abazana ibyo gutandukanya n'ibigusha binyurana n'ibyo mwize, mubazibukire

18.text: kuko abameze batyo atari imbata z'Umwami wacu Kristo, ahubwo ari iz'inda zabo, kandi imitima y'abatagira uburiganya bayohesha amagambo meza n'ibyo kubanezeza.

19.text: Igitumye mbabwira ibyo ni uko kumvira Imana kwanyu kwamamaye mu bantu bose. Ni cyo gitumye mbīshimira, ariko ndashaka ko muba abanyabwenge mu byiza mukaba abaswa mu bibi.

20.text: Imana nyir'amahoro izamenagurira Satani munsi y'ibirenge byanyu bidatinze.Ubuntu bw'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo bubane namwe.

21.text: Timoteyo dukorana arabatashyanya na Lukiyosi, na Yasoni na Sosipatiro dusangiye ubwoko.

22.text: Nanjye Terutiyo wanditse uru rwandiko mu Mwami wacu, ndabatashya.

23.text: Gayo arabatashya, uncumbikiye kandi agacumbikira abo mu Itorero bose. Erasito ubika impiya z'umusoro w'ab'uyu mudugudu, na Kwaruto mwene Data barabatashya.[

24.text: Ubuntu bw'Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo bubane namwe mwese, Amen.]

25.text: Imana ibasha kubakomeresha ubutumwa bwiza no kubwiriza ko ibya Yesu Kristo nababwirije bihuza n'ibanga ryahishwe uhereye kera kose,

26.text: ariko noneho rikaba rihishuwe ku bw'itegeko ry'Imana ihoraho, kugira ngo ibyanditswe n'abahanuzi bimenyeshwe n'abanyamahanga, bibayobore inzira yo kumvira no kwizera.

27.text: Icyubahiro kibe icy'Imana ifite ubwenge yonyine iteka ryose, ku bwa Yesu Kristo, Amen.
